title: Word Break
summary: Decide whether a string can be cut into pieces that are all dictionary words.

tests.explain: hot + dog + stand works (so does hotdog + stand).
car + pet leaves an s, and carp leaves ets. No split uses only dictionary words.
A word may be used more than once: ab + ab.

hints: Trying every way to cut the string is exponential: on 'aaaa…ab' a backtracking search explores a huge number of splits that all fail at the end.
Ask about prefixes: can s.slice(0, i) be split into words? The last word of such a split is s.slice(j, i) for some j < i.
canBuild[0] = true. canBuild[i] is true if some j < i has canBuild[j] true and s.slice(j, i) in a Set of the words. Return canBuild[s.length].

complexity.time: O(n × L × L): n end positions, up to L start positions each (L = longest word), and an O(L) slice and hash per check
complexity.space: O(n + total length of the words): the table and the word Set
